ATTESTATION, NOT FREQUENCY, AND NOT A DICTIONARY. Every entry means "this form occurs in Bugis Wikipedia article text, in at least two distinct non-bot-generated articles". It does NOT mean the form is a Bugis word: the corpus contains Indonesian, English and Vietnamese place names, and nothing here can tell them apart. Entries are marked attestation:"corpus", the reader badges them, and rank.ts scores them low. See data/lexicon/provenance.md.

A band is a claim about frequency and this corpus cannot support one.
